headline: Netanyahu Suggests Israel Could Use Crypto to Evade Sanctions
summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel should prepare to use cryptocurrency to circumvent potential economic sanctions, speaking ahead of general elections.
why: Government exploration of digital assets to bypass financial sanctions carries major implications for international sanctions enforcement and global anti-money-laundering rules.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrency
impacts.why: State consideration of crypto to evade sanctions risks triggering tighter regulatory crackdowns from global financial authorities.
